query:
SELECT 
  pbq.id AS quote_id,
  pbq.panel_beater_name,
  pbq.total_amount,
  pbq.currency,
  pbq.source_quote_index,
  pbq.line_item_completeness_score,
  pbq.line_items_sum_discrepancy_pct,
  pbq.completeness_status,
  COUNT(qli.id) AS line_item_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.line_total = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_price_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.category = 'paint' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paint_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.category = 'labor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS labour_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.category = 'sundries' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sundry_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.category = 'parts' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS parts_items
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = pbq.id
WHERE pbq.claim_id = 6240003
GROUP BY pbq.id, pbq.panel_beater_name, pbq.total_amount, pbq.currency, pbq.source_quote_index, pbq.line_item_completeness_score, pbq.line_items_sum_discrepancy_pct, pbq.completeness_status
ORDER BY pbq.id;
